rule.distribution: scene equal, rotation oversampled, remaining contact balanced; privileged train-label selection
rule.fill: alternate contact-only then other; skip exhausted/empty buckets
rule.repeats: only if total legal scene windows <scene quota; deterministic cycle of same scene order
rule.rotation: absolute wrapped target-control turn strictly >5 degrees, first up to scene quota
rule.scene_selection: round_robin; first ten scenes get21 and last two get20 per shape
